credit: Terrain: Vicmap Elevation (c) State of Victoria (Department of Transport and Planning), CC BY 4.0. Modified: interpolated to a grid, smoothed, flattened under roads.
format: terrain.bin: nx*ny uint16 heights (decimetres, row-major, y south), then nx*ny uint8 cover (0 ground, 1 park, 2 water, 3 site). Grid point (i, j) is at map px (i, j) * cell_m * px_per_m. Road profiles: decimetres every road_step_m along each roads.json polyline, same order as 'edges' and 'decor'.
